scripts.setup:control-plane: uv sync --project apps/control-plane --dev && bun run db:migrate
scripts.dev:control-plane: uv run --project apps/control-plane python apps/control-plane/manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:8000
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --project apps/control-plane python apps/control-plane/manage.py migrate
scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/web build && bun run --cwd apps/agent-runtime build
scripts.check: bun run build && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/agent-runtime typecheck && uv run --project apps/control-plane python apps/control-plane/manage.py check && uv run --project apps/control-plane ruff check apps/control-plane
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run --project apps/control-plane ruff format apps/control-plane
